name: qtim
description: Codex-native team orchestration with bounded verification, knowledge-base refresh, project-specific agents, risk-based review, PM planning, and explicit cross-dialog missions.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap Codex teams and cross-dialog missions
interface.longDescription: qtim adapts a project into a Codex-native team workflow for developers and PM/analysts. Setup generates a compact automatically loaded AGENTS contract, a track-aware charter, explicit Sol/Terra role profiles and durable memory. $qtim-minimal-diff selects the smallest complete design or implementation without cutting protected obligations. Reviewer is mechanically read-only; tester owns the recorded dev-server command and can use an opt-in one-retry browser-evidence gate. PM handoff routes by execution topology. Explicit $qtim-mission coordinates a validated DAG of visible Codex App tasks: read-only analysis, bounded node-local lazy teams, isolated writer worktrees, topological commit integration, clean-context verification, bounded fixes, and fail-visible status/resume/stop.
defaultPrompt: Set up qtim for this project
Run the qtim feature pipeline for this idea
Run qtim team-up for this epic
Run an approved multi-task plan as a qtim mission
Diagnose this non-trivial bug with qtim debug-loop
